home.hero_subheading: Describe the result you want — AI Creative Workstation takes care of the rest.
home.intent_placeholder: A cinematic portrait with dramatic lighting…
home.intent_hint: Paperclip or paste photos · Enter to continue
home.no_projects_desc: Projects you create or work on will appear here.
home.no_assets_desc: Images and characters you generate will appear here.
home.could_not_load_projects: Could not load your recent projects.
home.could_not_load_assets: Could not load your recent assets.

create.what_to_create: What do you want to create?
create.photos_lead: Add photos plus a scene description. Several photos cannot be glued into one frame yet — the model paints the scene from the prompt (faces will be similar in type, not a 1:1 copy).
create.intent_placeholder: e.g. Two boxers facing each other — keep the people from the photos
create.intent_hint: Clip or paste photos · Enter to send
create.no_model_installed: Download a model in Studio first.

error.title: Generation failed
error.sidecar_unavailable: The local AI engine is not responding. Restart the app and wait until the sidebar says Engine online.
error.mps_memory: The Mac GPU ran out of buffer for this job. Unload the model in Studio, pick Square, or attach fewer photos, then try again.
error.no_model: No active model. Open Studio, download a model, and click Use.

video.title: YouTube videos
video.lead: From scratch is not a motion model: we draw stills, then ffmpeg zooms and crossfades them. Real footage is From a recording. LTX/Wan in Studio are not wired yet.
video.no_library_audio: No tracks yet. Record or import them in Assets.
video.topic_placeholder: e.g. Why local AI image models finally work on a Mac…
video.topic_help: Write the subject in your own words — not the name of a button. We turn that subject into still pictures. Nothing is uploaded.
video.step_1: Write what the video is about (a sentence is enough).
video.step_2: Pick format and length. We will plan about {{count}} stills, {{seconds}}s each — one picture per beat, not camera footage.
video.step_3: Plan storyboard: we name the beats (open, middle, close). Gray boxes mean pictures are not drawn yet.
video.step_4: Generate stills: the image model in Studio draws one picture per beat from your topic. Open Studio if no image engine is ready.
video.step_5: Assemble MP4, then optionally add voice in Prompt edit (10s voice sample lives in Assets).
video.estimate_scenes: With this length we will make {{count}} stills, about {{seconds}} seconds each (YouTube-length videos use more stills; Shorts use fewer, shorter holds).
video.engine_draws: Pictures will be drawn with {{engine}}. Change it in Studio → Image.
video.need_image_engine: No ready image model. Video cannot invent stills until one is downloaded and loaded in Studio.
video.storyboard_help: This is a still storyboard, not camera footage. Assemble makes a Ken Burns montage with crossfades — people in the picture will not start moving.
video.next_draw: Next: draw the stills ({{drawn}} of {{count}} done). Nothing to upload — we use the topic above.
video.next_assemble: Stills are ready. Next: stitch the montage (zoom + crossfades). This is not generated motion.
video.click_draw: Press the orange button on the right: Draw stills from the topic.
video.topic_changed: The topic text changed. Update the storyboard or stills will follow the old topic.
video.hint_hook: First picture: the most striking image of your topic.
video.hint_establish: Show the idea clearly, like an establishing shot.
video.hint_insight: Show the key insight as a visual.
video.hint_outro: Last picture: memorable, no readable text in the image.
video.rec_step_1: Choose a screencast file on this Mac (Choose video). That is the only upload for this mode.
video.rec_step_2: Write what to strip (browser chrome, player buttons). Preview plan, then Clean video.
video.rec_step_3: Add captured audio or voiceover below. Record those in Assets first if the list is empty.
video.history_help: Each draw and assemble is saved on this Mac. Open a row to continue. Changing format or length keeps the old stills in this list.
video.fill_from_disk: Fill empty slots from recent stills on disk
video.fill_from_disk_help: Found pictures in Generated. If this is the same video, fill {{n}} empty slots (newest files, oldest of those first).
video.generating_scene: Drawing still {{current}} / {{total}} — wait, FLUX can take several minutes per picture.
video.generating_wait: The orange button stays disabled until this still finishes. An error from Create means the engine is stuck — quit and reopen the app, then try again.
video.preview_empty: The clip appears here after Assemble MP4. Draft only until you save.
video.draft_note: Draft only — not copied to your folders until you save.
video.dir_lead: The preview plays whatever is on the timeline. Add videos, trim In/Out, drop slices onto V1 one after another — that is the glue. Image on V2, audio on A1, caption on T1. Play moves the playhead across every track at once.
video.dir_bin_help: Add a clip, still, or audio. Select, set In/Out, send to a track. Click the ruler for the playhead.
video.dir_bin_empty: Add a file — it lands on the timeline right away (video/image on V1, audio on A1). Sources are the library for In/Out.
video.dir_cut_help: Seconds from the start of the source. Only that slice lands on the timeline.
video.dir_timeline_help: Playhead {{time}} · length {{total}}. Click the ruler or a lane. With playhead at 0, new clips append.
video.dir_ai_glue_need: AI glue needs a motion model (a short join between two clips). H3-Base is open on Hugging Face, but it is 33B — not a Mac sidecar. Until an engine is wired, glue is manual on the timeline.
video.dir_ai_xform_need: AI transform is image→video or clip rewrite with the same class of model. These buttons do not generate yet.
video.dir_board_empty: Drop files here. They go onto V1 / A1 automatically. Drag a clip onto V2+ to make an overlay.
video.dir_cut_empty: Select a file to trim In / Out. New files are already on the timeline.
video.dir_place_hint: New files go on V1/A1. Drag a clip onto V2+ for a picture-in-picture overlay. Edges resize the clip.
video.dir_preview_empty: Add video — it lands on V1 right away.
video.dir_play_hint: Space toggles play. Backspace removes the selected clip.
video.dir_edit_hint: Drag a clip along a track or onto another. Edges resize. × on a clip or track name deletes.
video.dir_decode_error: This file cannot decode in preview. Transcoding to H.264…
video.dir_proxying: Transcoding for preview — wait a moment.
video.dir_proxy_fail: Could not transcode preview. Install ffmpeg (brew install ffmpeg).
video.menu_hint: Drag by the title bar, edges resize. Window shows or hides blocks.
video.menu_layout_tile_hint: Blocks fill the space and push neighbours. Right edge = width, bottom = height, drag title to swap.
video.menu_layout_free_hint: Blocks float freely; neighbours do not react. Drag the title and any edge.
video.menu_all_hidden: All blocks are hidden. Enable them in the header.
video.dir_export_done: The video is ready. Save the file or discard the draft.
video.dir_export_need: Export renders exactly what is on the timeline. Add material to Sources and place it on a track.
video.dir_sent_to_timeline: Frames were added to Sources and placed on the V1 track — check Timeline and Result.
video.rec_sent_to_sources: "{{name}}" was added to Sources. Set In/Out and send it to a track.
video.timeline_need_video: Assemble or choose a video first.
video.timeline_voice_hint: Voiceover lines need a 10s sample in Assets and Coqui TTS (pip3 install TTS) in the sidecar.
video.clean_lead: Drop in a capture. The prompt tells the app what chrome to strip — browser UI, player controls, the stop button at the end.
video.clean_prompt_placeholder: Remove browser chrome, playback buttons, and the stop-recording UI at the end
video.timeline_lead: Describe timestamps: at 0:15 add the captured track; at 1:20 voiceover: your line.
video.timeline_placeholder:
at 0:05 add captured audio
на 1:20 озвучка: Привет

assets.title: Assets
assets.lead: Library of captures, voice sample, and source clips. Video mixes these tracks; Studio only shows whether a voice engine is ready.
assets.capture_lead: Record what the Mac is playing or the microphone. Saves WAV, MP3, or FLAC.
assets.audio_no_loopback: macOS did not attach system audio. Allow Screen Recording for this app, play sound, then try again. A virtual device like BlackHole also works.
assets.voice_lead: Record 10 seconds of your speech. Generate a voiceover in that voice (needs Coqui TTS in the sidecar).
assets.empty_library: Nothing here yet. Record system audio, the mic, or import a file.

threed.title: 3D
threed.lead: Image → mesh. Hunyuan3D 2 mini is the default when installed (stronger shapes). TripoSR stays as a lighter fallback. Prompt first draws a still with the image engine.
threed.mode_hint_photo: Choose a picture of a single object on a simple background. Front-ish view works best.
threed.mode_hint_prompt: Describe the object. The app generates a square still (FLUX/SDXL), then the active 3D engine turns that still into a mesh.
threed.mode_hint_photos: One photo is used for reconstruction. Select the view that shows the whole object most clearly.
threed.prompt_placeholder: e.g. a ceramic mug, white glaze, no background clutter
threed.photos_label: Photos — click the one to reconstruct
threed.no_reference: No photo yet. Choose a file, or generate a still in Create and it will appear here.
threed.no_photos: No photos yet. Choose one or more files, then click the thumbnail to use.
threed.need_image_engine: Prompt mode needs an image model (FLUX or SDXL) installed and set as active.
threed.generating_still_hint: Image engine is painting the reference. Mesh starts after that.
threed.generating_hint: First load of mesh weights can take a minute; later runs are faster.
threed.stage_load_weights_hint: First load of ~1.6 GB on CPU — later runs skip this
threed.stage_load_weights_hint_hunyuan: First load of Hunyuan3D 2 mini (~4 GB) — later runs skip this
threed.still_failed: The still was generated but the file path is missing.
threed.preview_empty: The mesh will appear here after you build it. It is a draft until you save.
threed.preview_hint: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. Color is projected from the photo (not PBR paint).
threed.draft_note: Draft only — not copied to your folders until you save.
threed.engine_missing: The 3D runtime is not installed in the sidecar.
threed.engine_setup: Run ./scripts/setup-hunyuan3d.sh (and ./scripts/setup-triposr.sh if you still want TripoSR), then restart.
threed.weights_missing: TripoSR weights are not on disk yet (~1.6 GB).
threed.weights_hf_fallback: Weights are not cached locally yet. Download in Studio → 3D.

create.uses: Create uses the image engine ({{engine}}). Stills land in Assets and can feed Video storyboards or 3D.

video.uses: From scratch, Video stills use the image engine ({{engine}}). Motion models are a separate Studio family — not required for montage from a recording.

threed.uses: 3D uses Hunyuan3D 2 mini when it is installed, otherwise TripoSR. Image engine ({{engine}}) only supplies the reference still.

assets.uses: Assets hold stills, audio, and later meshes. Video mixes tracks from here. Image engine: {{engine}}.

studio.title: Studio
studio.lead: Engines are grouped by job. Image, video, 3D, and voice are not interchangeable.
studio.family_hint_image: SDXL follows English more reliably. FLUX handles Russian better. Used by Create and by Video stills.
studio.family_hint_video: Needed only for generated motion. Today's Video page stills use the Image family; montage from a recording uses ffmpeg.
studio.family_hint_3d: Image→mesh. Download Hunyuan3D 2 mini here (shape only). Full Hunyuan paint needs NVIDIA.
studio.family_hint_voice: Sample and TTS live in Assets. This tab only shows whether the voice engine is ready.
studio.no_models_family: Nothing installed in this family yet.
studio.note_ltx: Text-to-video. Separate pipeline from image models.
studio.note_wan: Smaller motion model. Still a video pipeline, not FLUX.
studio.note_minimax_h3: H3-Base is open weights (~33B) on Hugging Face — a local model, not cloud-only. Hailuo on the site is the commercial 2K stack. It will not run next to FLUX on a Mac; you need your own GPUs. Download in this Studio is off until we have that path.
studio.note_triposr: Image → mesh (GLB/OBJ). Fast, weaker on people and bags.
studio.note_hunyuan3d: Hunyuan3D 2 shape (0.6B turbo). Stronger than TripoSR. No PBR paint on this Mac build.
studio.note_hunyuan3d_full: Full 2.0 + texture paint. Needs NVIDIA and extra CUDA ops — not wired here.
studio.not_in_ram_hint: Model files are on SSD but weights are not loaded into RAM. Unload appears after the first generation loads the model.
studio.unload_failed: Could not unload from RAM ({{reason}}). Restart the app if the badge stays on.
studio.unload_title: Unload from RAM. Files stay on disk and will reload on the next generation.
studio.unload_idle_title: Not in RAM — nothing to unload. Files stay on disk.
studio.delete_title: Delete files from disk and unload from RAM
studio.delete_confirm: Delete this model from disk? You will need to download it again.
studio.prompt_language_hint: SDXL follows English prompts more reliably. FLUX handles Russian better.
